Quick note from infra/sales ops perspective — Monica's timeline looks reasonable but two suggested changes:

- Move the VPC peering window earlier by one week (start 2027-06-07) to give more time for cert rotation and egress testing.
- Recommend pilot run on Redwood Dedicated (short-term reserved pool) to avoid noisy neighbor issues during the pilot; we'll reuse ephemeral instances for staging. Dedicated will add setup (billing/provisioning) of ~7 business days.

If ClearWave is okay with Dedicated for the pilot, we should shift the production target to 2027-09-22 to account for provisioning and procurement.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Adding a CS-run sprint schedule and acceptance criteria — pulled from the action grid and expanded into sprint tasks. Please review and call out any missing test cases: 

Sprint 0 (Prep, Days 0-3)
- Confirm SOW countersign (legal) — owner: Leo / Ben
- Share sample data export (ClearWave) — owner: Marie
- Network allowlist + KMS scope confirmed — owner: Ben

Sprint 1 (Validation, Days 4-14)
- Ingest sample dataset into staging; run validation harness (unit + smoke) — owner: Marissa
- KV cache priming and prefix tests — owner: Redwood runtime team (coord via Marissa)
- Latency baseline run (95th percentile) — owner: Marissa

Sprint 2 (Performance & Security, Days 15-28)
- Pen test scheduling + evidence capture for SOC2 items — owner: Ben
- Model QA and failure mode tests (synthetic prompts) — owner: Monica
- Observability hooks verified (traces + token cost breakdown) — owner: Marissa

Cutover checklist (Pre-go-live)
- Runbook dry-run + rollback test — owner: Marissa
- SLA notification & billing activation — owner: Ben

Acceptance criteria summary:
- Performance: 95th pctl latency < 250ms in staging under expected pilot load
- Quality: sample prompts regression delta < 2% vs baseline
- Security: SOC2 evidence items uploaded to shared drive + pen test scheduled

I'll own the runbook and post the first draft into the shared drive by EOD Monday. Monica: can you confirm the pilot user cohort (5 internal customers + 2 external partners) so I can size the load tests?

—Marissa
